name: Haiku dividend growth and income
strategy: Equal-weight portfolio of dividend aristocrats and dividend growth stocks spanning sectors. Emphasizes companies with 25+ year dividend increase streaks, strong free cash flow, and proven ability to grow dividends faster than inflation. Includes pure dividend-growth ETF exposure for systematic diversification.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: Portfolio combines proven income generation with dividend growth across sectors. Core holdings (JNJ, PG, PEP, KO) are dividend aristocrats with unbroken 25+ year dividend increase streaks. MSFT and AXP add growth vectors. ABBV and NEE provide higher current yields. SCHD captures systematic dividend growth factor exposure. Positioned to outperform through combination of capital appreciation and rising dividend income.
